TASK.TEXT: Far beyond the last lighthouse lies a stretch
of sea that sailors only whisper about. Its
currents are cold and quick, and fog rolls in
without warning. Many proud ships have sailed
into that grey water and never come home.
Deep below, their cargo still waits in the
sand: chests of coins, crowns and bright gems.
Brave divers go looking for it every summer,
but hungry sharks patrol the reefs. Only quick
fingers and a cool head will bring you back!
